alchaincyf-darwin-skill-root.description: 达尔文.skill (Darwin Skill 3.0): evolves and scores SKILL.md files. Use on: 优化skill, skill评分, skill打分, skill体检, 自动优化, 达尔文, darwin, optimize skill. Runs a skill against a bare-model baseline, blind-judges the real outputs, keeps only edits that measurably help and reverts the rest; 9-dim rubric, held-out tests, git rollback, human checkpoints.
